radiusSource: Radius 0.94 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Giacalone et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1860 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163...99G/abstract): 653,958 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.99 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Giacalone et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1860 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163...99G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
